_readme: Reviewed baseline for tests/unit/notification-silent-by-default-ratchet.test.ts (STD-SUBCOUNTDOWN-silent-by-default-emitters, CMT-1901). It lists what reaches a person by default WHILE the Quiet by Default gate is enforcing (with the gate off or in dry run, every category is delivered): every loud category, every registered sender into one, and every inline loud envelope literal per file. New senders ship silent: an addition here needs a reason in _why and review in the same change; an entry that stops being true must be removed.

_why.attention-item: Only an attention item carrying a significant class (security incident, data loss, agent cannot operate) pushes; plain items stay quiet.
_why.update-announcement: Only a release the audience rules promote pushes; the owner can quiet it.
_why.presence-standby: Conversation serving: answers a waiting message from the person.
_why.cold-start-fallback: Conversation serving: says a conversation is unavailable to the person who wrote.
_why.message-loss-notice: Conversation serving: tells the person a message of theirs was lost.
_why.command-response: Conversation serving: the answer to the person's own command.
_why.disk-steward: A disk floor warning must reach a person (no-data-loss-on-machine-death D13); the owner can quiet it.
_why.never-silent-notice: The one outcome besides a reply when a person's message goes unanswered (never-silent spec section 2).
_why.pairing-outcome: Answers the operator's own pairing request in its topic.
_why.owner-decision: A decision only the owner can make, budgeted per topic.
_why.promise-notice: The agent's own promise to the person, budgeted per topic.
_why.src/monitoring/DiskStewardPoster.ts: The disk floor warning; must reach a person (D13), the owner can quiet it.
_why.src/server/routes.ts#promise-notice: The commitment check-in or late-promise line in the person's own conversation, capped per topic.
_why.src/server/routes.ts#profile-confirmatio: Confirming an engine change the owner asked for; needs the owner's answer.
_why.producer:presence-proxy: The standby line answering a person who is waiting for a reply.
_why.producer:auto-updater: Update notes; only a release the audience rules promote pushes.
_why.producer:post-update: Post-update notes; only a promoted release pushes.
_why.producer:never-silent: The notice that a person's message is still waiting (never-silent floor).
_why.src/commands/server.ts: Server composition: lost-message and standby notices answering a person's own message (4 literals).
_why.src/lifeline/TelegramLifeline.ts: The lifeline telling a person their message could not be delivered (1 literal).
_why.src/messaging/NotificationSelectivityGat: The gate itself: store-failure data-loss attention item, its significant classes, and command responses (6 literals).
_why.src/messaging/TelegramAdapter.ts: sendOfferList owner-decision envelope and command responses to the person's own command (2 literals).
_why.src/messaging/telegram-origin/TelegramOr: The promoted release announcement through the origin service (2 literals).
_why.src/monitoring/SessionMonitor.ts: The parameter type of the lost-message and standby notice to a person whose session died; the send itself passes { category } through a variable (1 literal, a type annotation).
_why.src/server/routes.ts: Route composition: update announcements, command responses, standby and pairing-outcome replies (6 literals).
